header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Agha Iftikhar Hussain Tareen advocate for the
Mr. Muhammad Sharif Solangi, A.A.G a/w Mr. Moula
body: Bux, X.E.N Tube Well Division Hala-II.
Through instant Petition, the petitioner is seeking directions to the respondents to issue Appointment Order to the petitioner. After notice, the respondents have filed their comments.

Today respondent No.6, while filing comments, submits that case of the petitioner has been processed for verification of documents and fitness medical certificate; however, whenever formalities are completed appointment order shall be issued to the petitioner.

In view of such a situation, instant Petition is disposed of with direction to the respondents to complete the process within 15 days and issue appointment order to the petitioner. JUDGE JUDGE “Saleem”
